summary: First end-to-end test of Health Experts CRM. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth, RBAC (agent forbidden from create-user/assign/import), leads CRUD + filters, lead detail with unmasked phone/medicare/medicaid fields, notes, call logs, activity feed (sorted desc), manual assign + round-robin, agent create/update/reset-password, owner & agent dashboards, leaderboard with rank/conversion_rate, 16 default statuses + create status, company settings get/patch, CSV import preview + commit, duplicates groups. Frontend: owner login -> /dashboard renders all KPI cards (Total Leads 52, Sold 4, Appointments 5, etc.) with charts. /leads shows 52 rows; lead detail page opens with log-call-button + lead-status-select. agent1 login redirects to /my-leads, shows only 10 scoped leads, sidebar correctly restricted to agent-allowed nav items.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1130 lines in a single file — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, leads.py, imports.py, dashboard.py) for maintainability when adding features.

CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=False; httpOnly cookies are set on login but the frontend uses Bearer tokens from localStorage — the cookie auth path is effectively unused cross-origin. Either tighten CORS to FRONTEND_URL with allow_credentials=True (to use cookies) or remove the cookie-set code to avoid confusion.
No brute force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login. Production should add IP/email throttling after N failures.
JWT secret is committed in /app/backend/.env (acceptable for dev seed). Ensure it is rotated for production.

/api/leads/export/csv accepts a Bearer token only via the standard auth flow — file download from browser won't include Authorization header unless frontend fetches+blob-saves; verify the UI uses that pattern.
/api/leads round-robin endpoint loops one-update-at-a-time; for very large unassigned sets, consider bulk_write for performance.

Routing: POST /api/leads/{lead_id} would collide with /api/leads/{action} style — currently safe because only specific POST sub-paths (assign, round-robin, bulk-status) exist and the LeadIn POST is on /leads exactly; just a future-foot-gun to be aware of.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (owner login, dashboard KPIs, leads list, lead detail, agent login + scoped /my-leads, role-restricted sidebar all verified)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (1 owner + 3 agents + 50 leads). Tests created TEST_-prefixed agents, notes, call logs, statuses, and 2 imported leads — these are isolated and safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_crm_backend.py is the regression set; run via `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_crm_backend.py -v`. Auth uses Bearer (access_token from login response) — backend also sets httpOnly cookies but frontend uses Bearer/localStorage so CORS allow_origins=* with allow_credentials=False is intentional. Lead detail tabs: Activity (default), Notes (has add-note-button), Calls (has log-call-button). All seeded leads visible to owner; agents see only their own (lead_scope_filter).
